JOB TITLE
Intern – BI/AI (Data analytics)

Internship Student

DEPARTMENT
IT Department

JOB SUMMARY

Join our BI/AI team and get hands-on experience working with real business data and use cases. You will help build dashboards, analyse trends, and support AI-driven initiatives that improve daily operations and decision-making.

In this role, you will work with tools such as data platforms, ETL processes, reporting dashboards, and automation solutions, while collaborating with both IT and business teams. This is a practical opportunity to learn modern tools, solve real problems and understand how data drives tangible business impact in a corporate environment.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES / AUTHORIZATION LEVEL

- Support the rollout of enterprise BI dashboards across multiple sites by replicating, adapting, and deploying proven reporting solutions.
- Assist in building and enhancing Power BI dashboards to support business operations, planning and management reporting
- Work with real datasets to analyse trends, identify gaps, and support data-driven decision-making
- Perform data preparation (ETL) and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across different data sources and sites
- Collaborate with business users (eg. Finance, Operations, Planning, and Engineers) to gather requirements and support UAT and deployment
- Contribute to new analytics and AI use cases, including process improvements and automation initiatives.
- Troubleshoot data/reporting issues and support continuous improvements post-deployment
- Document data logic, report structures, and rollout approach to enable scalable deployment across Venture Groupwide
- Gain exposure to enterprise data platforms and understand how standardized analytics solutions are scaled across regions.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
- Strong interest in data analytics, business intelligence, and AI-driven applications
- Basic understanding of data analysis concepts (eg. Data modelling, data transformation, reporting)
- Exposure to tools eg. Excel, SQL, PowerBI, data engineering concepts through coursework or projects
- Familiar with ETL processes, data modelling, or cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure) is a plus.

JOB-RELATED SKILLS & PRE-REQUISITES

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail
- Willingness to learn and work with real business data and cross-functional teams
- Good communication skills to translate data into meaningful insights.
